answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 2004 Country: India Title: Can a Muslim undergo a Homeopathy Treatment. I mean In Homeopathy medicines they use lot of alcohol. so please tell me is it permissible to use them? Question: As Salaam Mu Alikum, Dear Brother Please guide me urgently in the following matters. (My previous one were not answered and i m still waiting) 1. Can a muslim undergo a Homeopathy Treatment. I mean In Homeopathy medicines they use lot of alcohol. so please tell me is it permissible to use them. Waiting for the reply. Answer ID: 2004 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1151/1081=H) Nowadays, the alcohols used in medicines and perfumes are not made of grapes and dates but from potato, vegetables and coals; therefore medicines containing a little amount of it will be allowed provided they do not cause intoxication. This is the maslak of Imam Abu Hanifa and Imam Abu Yusuf, based upon their opinions, the use homeopathic and allopathic medicines is permissible. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
